# BEHIR-CLASS MEDIUM SIZE SALVAGE SHUTTLE
"The Behir is designed for Interplanetary asset liquidation, and long range cargo transport."
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Medium
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 2-4

[color=#a4885c]Expedition Capable:[/color] Yes

# Shuttle Brief
"A heavily modified long range cargo transport shuttle, purchased by Derelict Industries Reclamation & Enhancement, heavily modified for planetary based expeditions, large bay doors for ease of access cargo storage, with a small dorm room and comfy lounge."
"Manufactured by DIRE"
# The DIRE Touch
Every standard Behir comes equipped with a Salvage Techfab, Mercenary Techfab, Salvage Lockers filled with adequate amenities for Mining and Ship Breaking, and a lounge to maintain comfort during long outings.
DIRE believes in the ease of modification, and has supplied the ship with High Voltage Cabling running back to front, to make future additions, repurposement, or modification simple.
The underside of every Airlock of a Behir vessel is piped with Air Distrobution and Waste Distrobution pipes, both offset, along with Air Mix pipes going through the center, to remove the need to tear doorways up to add more intricate piping systems.
*NOTE: DIRE recommends safe practices when modifying ships, and will always come with a getting started package, including shock resilient gloves, gas safety masks, and a radiation suit, alongside the supplimented EVA abundantly available around the ship.
There are buttons placed throughout the ship, marked with unique frames.
- The Yellow and Black caution framed buttons are for toggling Blast Doors
- The Grey framed buttons toggle shutters.
- The Red and Black framed button controls Command Bay door bolting, along with having two buttons for turning the ship Thrusters On, and Off.
- The Purple switch indicates a light switch.
# Piloting your Behir
Your Shuttle Console is your means of manuevering your vessel throughout space. Always practice safe flying techniques while piloting.
Your NAV page is for basic navigation and vision via Radar.
- Cruise allows for flight without needing to hold a direction, and can be used to relax during long trips. Ensure you still pay mind to your flight path.
- Drive will have guided braking as you fly, helping maintain control of the Vessel.
- Park significantly slows your vessel, and allows for safe docking. Ensure to make use of it during need for emergency breaking controls.
Your DOCK page is used for Docking to stations, ships, and general points of interest.
- Ensure you have announced your desired docking location over Shortband, to minimize chances of collision, and to avoid fines when docking to larger stations, such as Venmar.
- Always announce your intention over shortband when docking to anothers Vessel.
# Expeditions
Expeditions are a common way for Mercenaries to make money performing jobs posted on the Expeditionary Consoles Net Interface.
Always observe the Conditions of the planet before accepting, such as Atmospheric conditions, Difficulty, and what your Mission fulfillment requirements are.
A Universal Pinpointer is helpful for locating your Vessel during outings.
*NOTE: DIRE heavily recommends bringing adequate medical equipment on such outings, or hiring a personal capable of doing so.
# Hiring crew
As a Captain of a Spacefaring vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will.
You may do so at your Station Records Computer, located in the Engineering Bay of your Behir-Class Vessel.
Simply place what you desire in the Advertisement field, along with general expectations, and the pay you plan to give.
*NOTE: DIRE is not responsible for unruly crew hired.
# PREFLIGHT CHECKLIST
## 1. S.U.P.E.R.P.A.C.M.A.N. Portable Generators
- Secure yourself in protective hazardous material PPE. There should be a Radiation Suit in your starting care package, nearby the Generators. - Add Uranium Fuel to ensure it is adequatelly filled. - Ensure it is on, and it is set to Target Power (kW) 27 per Generator. Adding machines will raise the power draw requirement. - Processed Uranium can be also be used to fuel the Generator.
## 2. Battery units
- Observe the Substations. Ensure its Passthroughs IN is Higher than, or equal to, its OUT. - Adjust the Generators Target Power to match the Substations OUT Requirements. - Ensure every APC in the ship is Toggled (ON). - Verify each APC unit registers some load, if not this may indicate problems. - Located inside the Command Bay, are buttons for turning the Thrusters (ON) and (OFF). - While the Thrusters have been powered (OFF), the required Target Power (kW) may be lowered to 19 (kW) Total (8 (kW) per Generator), for longevity during downtine, and a lack of need for thrusters. - Ensure the Generators Target Power (kW) is raised back to the Recommended 27 (kW) per Generator When travel is to be resumed, and the Thrusters have been Toggled (ON).
## 3. Ship Mobilty and Gravity
- Ensure your Mini Gravity Generatory is powered (ON). - Ensure your Gyroscope's are powered (ON). - Observe the Thrusters on the outside of the ship, and ensure they are powered and (ON).
## 4. Atmosphere Distribution Network
- Ensure oxygen and nitrogen canisters are anchored firmly to their connector ports. - Verify the Gas Mixer is configured to 79% on its primary port (N2) and 21% on is side port (O2). Adjust for comfort of specific species, such as 22-24% (O2) for Harpies. - Set the Output Pressure to 101.3 (kPa), and ensure it is Toggled (ON). - Observe the Manual Valve next to your SMES. Twist the valve to open, if you wish to expel the gas in the Waste Network. - Ensure Air Alarms are ON, and do not display warnings.
